components.name: Chart/KPI card
components.description: One number that matters, with direction and context. Default: label, value (Headline/M, tabular), Chart/Delta, Sparkline, comparison period. Compact: for dense grids and Mobile rows. Progress: value vs goal. Value uses uz-UZ format (12 480; 4,8 mln). React: <KpiCard label value delta trend variant="default|compact|progress" goal? />
